admission.justification: Made-up-account tests pin refusal before creation; this prevents shared support from overwriting live user settings and disabling role transport.

applicability: Shared test-support operations requesting the product user settings path for mutation.
conditions: The protected path is the account-database home plus .config/agents-remember/settings.json when available; otherwise it is the guard-first-observed home plus that suffix.
The comparison includes direct and realpath equality and occurs before returning the path.
exclusions: Product settings readers and migration, which are unchanged.
Knowledge of a HOME value mutated before guard import when the account database is unreadable.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_user_settings_guard.py::test_the_guard_refuses_the_made_up_real_path_and_creates_nothing, ::test_the_guard_without_an_account_database_compares_and_refuses_a_match, ::test_the_guard_reports_the_home_it_actually_observed; worker report attempt3 + evidence/freeze-manifest-r2.md; CODE PASS verdict-code-r4.md on attempt3

statement: Test support refuses the account's real settings path before anything is written, returning only provably moved paths.
